notes.title: What Could Be Inside the Mysterious 7th Chapter?
notes.content:
Hey adventurers! 🌌

If you’ve completed all 6 chapters of A Tiny Space Adventure, you might have seen something... curious. A 7th chapter appears — but it’s locked, hidden, sealed tight. Why?

Well, let’s just say Elsa might have been working on something important… something delicious… something that could change the galaxy. 🛸🍪

But before we reveal anything, we’d love to hear from you:

🧠 What do you think is inside Chapter 7?
🤖 A surprise twist?
🍰 A strange experiment gone wrong?
👽 An alien baking competition?
🎶 Or maybe something you never expected?

Drop your craziest theories and ideas below!
We’re listening 👂 and who knows… maybe your suggestion will shape what’s to come. 😉

(P.S. We’re not saying it’s cookies… but we’re not saying it’s not, either.)

Link: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2790270/discussions/0/595146960680290436/]HERE![/url]
